name: AIReg-Bench-llm
description: AIReg-Bench-llm evaluates large language models on tasks related to AI regulation, policy interpretation, and compliance. It contains multiple-choice and open-ended prompts derived from regulatory texts and hypothetical scenarios to measure factual knowledge, legal reasoning, and instruction-following in regulatory contexts.
reputation: Emerging benchmark on Hugging Face with growing interest among researchers studying regulatory compliance and alignment.
